name: LIBERTY
versions: single version; limited market release 2025-2026, full launch from SIR April 2026
target_anatomy: peripheral arterial/visceral (PAE, UFE, GAE, Y90, peripheral); neurovascular only a stated future target
devices_driven: guide catheter, microcatheter, guidewire (telescopic); standard 0.014-0.018-in guidewires with compatible microcatheters (2-3 F) and guide catheters (4-6 F) (cornelis2026_in p. 3); in the 20-patient study the robot advanced microwire and microcatheter (0.014-0.016-in wires, 2.7 F Progreat or Truselect), guide catheters (typically 5 F) placed by hand (cornelis2026_in p. 3-5, Fig. 2b); tested 0.016-in microwire, 2.4 F microcatheter, 5 F guide (vidal2024_performance)
translation_detail: friction-roller (inferred; mechanism not described in vidal2024_performance)
footprint_mm: palm-size drive (vidal2024_performance); 'handheld' system fixed to the angiography table by a mounting arm (cornelis2026_in p. 2-3, Fig. 1b)
mass_kg: <1 each for drive and wireless hand controller (vidal2024_performance)
haptics_leader: no: remote controller operable up to 30 ft (9.1 m) away, e.g. from the control room (cornelis2026_in p. 3, Fig. 6b); wireless handheld per vidal2024_performance
imaging_compat: fluoroscopy with registered DSA overlay (cornelis2026_in Fig. 2a); drive on a mounting arm fixed to the angiography table (Fig. 1b)
sterility: fully disposable, single-use system: robotic drive, mounting arm and remote controller (cornelis2026_in p. 2, Fig. 1)
validation_detail: 20 pts treated (21 screened), 3 centres (MSKCC, Miami Cardiac & Vascular Institute, Brigham and Women's), 3 interventional radiologists, 3-day follow-up; Y-90 mapping 10, UFE 3, haemangioma 2, TACE 2, sacral, intercostal and pulmonary 1 each; robot removed before embolisation (cornelis2026_in); 2 pigs x 6 operators (vidal2024_performance); simulator benchmark
key_numbers: navigation to target without conversion 20/20 (95% CI 83.2-100%); robotic navigation 6.3+-7.6 min (median 3, range 1-32) of 120.1+-34.5 min procedure; fluoroscopy median 7.9 min; operator dose median 1.4 uSv (abstract; 1.46 uSv in Table 2) (cornelis2026_in). Wiring on PCI simulator 27.1 s vs manual 36.9 s vs GRX 62.3 s (winsor2024_performance). FDA 510(k) K243789 decided 2025-09-04.
